What's new in DuckOS 1.0.88

• DuckAI answers in the language you speak or write, even when you switch between English, German and Turkish in one chat.
• DuckAI understands German and Turkish commands right away: "Kannst du WhatsApp öffnen?", "Taschenlampe an", "Lautstärke auf 30", "WhatsApp'ı aç", "saat kaç" and more.
• DuckAI can open every app on your phone, use the shortcuts apps offer (a WhatsApp chat, a new incognito tab in Chrome), send text into any app, and write WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal messages for you to send.
